Background of Raghav Jhunjhunwala
Raghav Jhunjhunwala is from Muzaffarpur, Bihar . He completed his schooling in Bihar before pursuing higher education in Delhi.
His academic record shows consistent performance across school and college. He graduated in B.A. (Hons.) Economics from Shri Ram College of Commerce (SRCC), University of Delhi (2022)

During his college years, he also demonstrated academic distinction and leadership. He received the Charat Ram Gold Medal for academic excellence at SRCC and was involved in initiatives like financial literacy drives through student organisations.
Raghav Jhunjhunwala Association with VisionIAS

During the later stages of his preparation, Raghav Jhunjhunwala was associated with VisionIAS through the Interview Development Programme , which supported him in preparing for the Personality Test stage of the UPSC examination.
